expectations.text: Cites Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/1755, published in the OJ July 21, 2026 and in force August 10, 2026
expectations.evidence: Never cites Regulation 2026/1755; says implementing acts "were in development (consultation drafts in 2026) and I cannot confirm final adoption details."

expectations.text: Covers model evaluations including API, source code and model access under Article 92(3)
expectations.evidence: "Art. 92: power to conduct evaluations, including via independent experts, with access to the model through APIs or source code where necessary"

expectations.text: Covers the appointment and independence of external experts
expectations.evidence: Mentions evaluations "via independent experts" in passing but never covers how experts are appointed or how independence is ensured.

expectations.text: Covers fine proceedings: preliminary findings, the right to be heard, and access to the file
expectations.evidence: "there is a right to be heard"; "chance to respond to preliminary findings"; access to file flagged as fixed in the implementing act.

expectations.text: States the five-year limitation period for fines
expectations.evidence: Says only "Limitation periods... are the details I would expect to be fixed in the implementing act"; the five-year period is never stated.
